title: CRLR/142/2017 of Ashok Kumar Sharma Vs Smt. Rajni Chaudhary AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Criminal Revision No. 142 of 2017
Ashok Kumar Sharma Ö..Revisionist
Versus
Smt. Rajni Chaudhary & another Ö.Respondents
Ms. Anjali Noliyal, Advocate for the revisionist.
Mr. Vivek Shukla, Advocate for the respondent.
Dated: 12.10.2017
Honíble V.K. Bist, J.
 Heard.
2. This criminal revision has been preferred by
the revisionist against the judgment and order dated
28.04.2017 passed by the learned Judge, Family
Court, Haridwar in Criminal Case No. 207 of 2014
ìSmt. Rajni & another vs. Ashok Kumar Sharmaî
under Section 125 of Cr.P.C., whereby the application
under Section 125 Cr.P.C. filed by respondents has
been allowed.
3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the
parties that in connected criminal revision bearing
CRLR No. 207 of 2017, the matter was placed before
the Mediation Centre of this Court. In the mediation
proceeding, the parties have arrived at following
compromise:
ì1. Both the parties shall withdraw all
pending Criminal revisions no. 142 of 2017,
Ashok Kumar Sharma Vs. Smt. Rajni
Chaudhary, Criminal revision no. 207 of
2017, Smt. Rajni and another Vs. Ashok
Kumar Sharma and another, F.A. No. 57 of
2017, Ashok Kumar Sharma Vs. Smt. Rajni
Chaudhary, F.A. No. 77 of 2017, Smt. Rajni
Vs. Ashok Kumar Sharma filed/ preferred
against each other in this Court or in any

2
other Courts of law and shall not prosecute
further with regard to their marriage which
is coming to an end by way of this
agreement. All the allegation and the counter
allegation with respect to the character of
each other shall be withdrawn from today
itself against each other by the parties and
the allegation made in their pleading of the
aforesaid cases shall not be read against
each other.
2. The husband Ashok Kumar Sharma
will pay to the wife Rajni and his son Master
Atin sum of Rs. 20,00,000/- (Rs. Twenty
Lakhs) out of which Rs. 2,00,000/- (Rs. Two
lakh) shall be paid in cash and sum of Rs.
18,00,000/- (Rs. Eighteen lakh) shall be
paid by way of demand draft to Smt. Rajani
payable at PNB Shivalik Nagar Haridwar, on
or before 12.10.2017.
3. That out of Rs. 18,00,000/- (Rs.
Eighteen lakh) the respondent wife shall
deposit the Rs. 10,00,000/- (Rs. Ten lakh) in
the interest earning fixed deposit scheme in
the name of Master Atin Kumar son of Ashok
Kumar Sharma and mother Smt. Rajani
Chaudhary till his attaining majority i.e. till
he attains the age of 18 years.
4. That respondent wife Smt. Rajni
Chaudhary will bear all the responsibility
and the expenses of education, food and
clothing etc. of the child Master Atin Kumar
and no further claim shall be made by the
husband Ashok Kumar Sharma to seek
custody of Master Atin by from mother Rajni
Chaudhary and Master Atin shall be entitled
for medical benefits/ facilities as provided by
BHEL to his father Mr. Ashok Kumar
Sharma.
5. That the parties shall get the decree of
divorce in pursuance of this settlement. In
full and final permanent alimony, sum of
Rs. 20,00,000/- (twenty lakh) shall be paid
by the husband to the wife and the child and
the wife Rajni Chaudhary will not claim any
further maintenance or any other claim from
the husband (Mr. Ashok Kumar Sharma).

3
But the son property from his father and his
father Mr. Ashok Kumar Sharma shall not
be entitled to alienate the share of master
Atin Kumar.
6. That the both the parties undertake to
give respect and honor to their respective
families as well as the families of both the
parties.
7. That the parties hereto confirm and
declare that they have voluntarily & out of
their own free will arrived at this settlement/
agreement in the presence of their respective
Advocates.
8. That the settlement has been read over
& explained to the parties in their own
language in presence of their advocates.
Signature of parties are also identified by
their Advocates.
9. That both the parties are bound by the
terms & conditions of the settlement
agreement.î

4. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the
parties that according to the compromise held in the
mediation proceeding, a sum of Rs. 18 lakhs by way of
demand draft and Rs. 2 lakhs as cash has already been
given by the revisionist to Smt. Rajni-respondent no. 1.
Parties are present in the Court and they submits that
they have seen the compromise and they have
agreeable for the same. The compromise deed has
already been placed on record in connected Criminal
Revision No. 207 of 2017.
5. Learned counsel for the parties submitted
that the settlement arrived at by the parties be
recorded. Learned counsel for the revisionist submitted
that the revision be dismissed as not pressed.

4
6. In view of above stated facts, the prayer is
allowed and revision is dismissed as not pressed.
7. Let a copy of this judgment be supplied
today itself.
 (V.K. Bist, J.)
 12.10.2017
Navin
